content.value_statement: Finding a memorable domain can take hours of manual searching and comparison. This skill generates brandable options, organizes TLD choices, and frames availability checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates domain name ideas from a project, product, or brand description.
Suggests options across common TLDs such as .com, .io, .dev, .ai, and .app.
Explains why each name may fit the audience, market, or product category.
Provides variations when a preferred name or extension is unavailable.
Summarizes pricing context for standard, premium, and alternative TLDs.
Supports prompts for industries, keywords, multilingual names, and competitor patterns.
limitations: Live availability and prices can change, so users must verify domains with a registrar.
Trademark checks require legal review before launch or purchase.
The skill does not register domains or manage registrar accounts.
Results depend on the project details and naming constraints provided by the user.

use_cases.title: Name a New Startup
use_cases.description: Generate short, memorable domains for a company idea and compare .com, .io, and .ai options.

use_cases.title: Choose a Product Domain
use_cases.description: Create product-focused domain options that match the target market, features, and preferred keywords.

use_cases.title: Plan a Personal Brand
use_cases.description: Find domain variations for a portfolio, independent practice, or professional site.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Domain Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a broad first pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate domain name ideas for my project. The project is: [describe project]. Prefer clear names and common TLDs.

prompt_templates.title: Use Keywords and TLDs
prompt_templates.scenario: Adds naming constraints and extension preferences.
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest domain names for [project]. Include the words [keywords] when useful. Focus on [TLD list] and explain the best options.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Brand Directions
prompt_templates.scenario: Explores several naming styles for a launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create domain ideas for [audience] using descriptive, abstract, and premium-sounding styles. Group results by naming style and TLD.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Competitor Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review domain patterns used by successful [industry] products, then suggest available-style names for [project] with rationale and risks.

output_examples.input: I am building a project management tool for remote teams.
output: TeamNest.io: short, collaboration-focused, and suitable for a remote work product.
AsyncBoard.com: describes asynchronous planning and keeps a business-friendly .com option.
FlowCrew.app: direct product signal for teams that manage shared work.

output_examples.input: Suggest domain ideas for a personal finance app using calm, trustworthy names.
output: PocketHarbor.com: suggests safety and money management without sounding complex.
SteadyMint.app: modern, simple, and suitable for a mobile finance product.
ClearLedger.io: more technical, useful for budgeting or reporting tools.

output_examples.input: Find naming directions for an AI writing assistant with .ai or .io domains.
output: DraftPilot.ai: clear connection to guided writing and AI support.
InkSignal.io: brandable and useful for an editorial workflow tool.
PhraseLift.ai: action-oriented name for improving drafts.

best_practices: Give the audience, product category, preferred tone, and any required keywords.
Ask for several naming styles before choosing a final direction.
Verify domain availability, price, social handles, and trademarks before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for one perfect name without sharing project context.
Do not assume listed availability is final without registrar verification.
Do not choose a name before checking pronunciation, spelling, and legal risks.

faq.question: Can this skill confirm domain availability?
faq.answer: It can structure availability checks and report findings when live lookup is available. Always verify with a registrar before purchase.

faq.question: Which TLDs does it support?
faq.answer: It covers common choices such as .com, .io, .dev, .ai, .app, .co, .xyz, .design, and .tech.

faq.question: Can it help with premium domains?
faq.answer: Yes. It can flag likely premium or taken names and suggest lower-cost alternatives.

faq.question: Does it replace trademark research?
faq.answer: No. It can remind users to check trademarks, but legal review is required for brand decisions.

faq.question: Can it create multilingual domain ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. Users can request names in specific languages and ask for pronunciation or meaning notes.

faq.question: Does it register domains automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill only helps brainstorm, compare, and plan domain choices.
